title.en: waluw vintage and design market, christmas edition.
title.tr: waluw vintage ve tasarım pazarı, noel sürümü.

line.en: vintage and design stalls at edge on coolsingel, 10:30 to 16:30, entry €7.50 in advance or €8 at the door. a slow sunday morning with a coffee in hand.
line.de: vintage- und designstände im edge am coolsingel, 10:30 bis 16:30, eintritt 7,50 euro im vorverkauf oder 8 euro an der tür. ein ruhiger sonntagvormittag mit kaffee.
line.tr: edge coolsingel'de vintage ve tasarım tezgahları, 10:30-16:30. ön satış 7,50 euro, kapıda 8 euro. kahveyle yavaş bir pazar sabahı.

sparks.why: Waluw Vintage & Design Market, Christmas edition, Sun 6.12 10:30-16:30 at EDGE Coolsingel 75, with entry prices, from search results citing the Waluw listing; the organiser page itself was not opened.
